sql:
SELECT g.display_name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS movie_count
FROM titles t
JOIN titles_genres tg ON tg.title_id = t.id
JOIN genres g ON g.id = tg.genre_id
WHERE t.title_type = 'movie'
GROUP BY g.id, g.display_name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC
summary: 共发现 0 个性能问题。SQL结构良好：明确列出SELECT列、所有JOIN均有ON条件、无子查询、无函数包裹列、无NOT IN、COUNT(DISTINCT)在此场景下必要（一部电影可属于多个类型）、有ORDER BY。LIMIT由run_sql参数控制，符合规范。
